notes.title: Information on new game release
notes.notes:
The store page of the new game "Infinos Gaiden" has been released.
"Infinos Gaiden" is a 90's arcade style side scrolling shooter.
The demo version has already been released. Please try it!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/771070/Infinos_Gaiden/

notes.title: Update information(3/5)
notes.notes:
We had updated "Battle Crust" to V.1.02.
Input bug of particular controller(such as HORI Fighting Stick EX2 for XBOX360) was fixed.
Please confirm.

In "OPTION", you can find "1.02".  If it is "1.01", please restart your Steam client.

notes.title: Update information(2/28)
notes.notes:
"Battle Crust" has been updated.
I had received the bug reports of joystick.
But my controllers have no bug from the previous in this game.
For this reason, I can not confirm whether the bug has been fixed.

If you have a controller that was not recognized, Please check whether it has been modified, and please report to me.
